summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SafeMedAI MVP - medication safety app for seniors. Backend APIs working well (13/15 tests passed), frontend UI fully functional with proper authentication flow, risk assessment, and chat features.

minor_bugs.issue: Seed endpoint response format inconsistency when data already exists
minor_bugs.impact: Demo data loading may show confusing response

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero image, Sign In button, feature cards, and How It Works section
Authentication flow redirects properly to Emergent Google Auth
Backend API /api/auth/me returns 401 when not authenticated
Backend API /api/users/role updates user role successfully
Backend API /api/patients CRUD operations work correctly
Backend API /api/upload/{patient_id} accepts file uploads
Backend API /api/process/{document_id} processes documents and returns risk results
Backend API /api/risk-results/{patient_id}/latest returns risk assessment
Backend API /api/chat/{patient_id}/messages sends message and receives AI response
Backend API /api/alerts returns alerts list
Backend API /api/dashboard/stats returns dashboard statistics
Dashboard page loads with stats, risk summary cards, and patient list
Patient profile page shows patient details and navigation
Risk results page shows score card, medications table, flagged medications, and recommendations
Chat page has message input, suggestion buttons, and AI responses
Alerts page shows alerts with severity-based styling
Role-based authentication and navigation working properly
Seed data creates 3 demo patients with pre-generated risk data
ACB risk scoring engine calculates scores correctly
OpenAI Vision integration processes documents successfully
